title: How should I specify technical requirements when buying eight heat-treatment furnaces at once?
summary: Furnaces purchased together do not necessarily perform the same task. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s eight-furnace package dated 8 August 2023 covers electroslag-ingot annealing, electrode and slag baking, solution treatment, ageing, diffusion annealing and launder baking. Each has separately specified handling, heat sources and proposed acceptance criteria. Map every unit to its workpieces, process and site interfaces; one total load or temperature criterion cannot describe the whole package.
